reproducedDefect.trigger: A desktop resize commits a different More-menu layout while focus restoration is queued; the user then focuses content/branding or clicks non-focusable page content.
reproducedDefect.cause: The queued callback captured a target and restored it unconditionally; existing cancellation guarded breakpoint restoration but not desktop overflow restoration.
reproducedDefect.fix: Read live overflow intent in the callback; cancel it on new focus or an outside pointer choice; preserve a currently visible focus destination and restore without scrolling.
